fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the installation of VsCode tunnel (code-tunnel) as a service.
fields.name: Visual Studio Code Tunnel Service Installation
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "tunnel " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "service" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "internal-run" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "tunnel-service.log"))
